Card Q&A.a: Tokens are special cards that some effects put into play to represent Digimon or Tamers. This card's effect, for example, plays tokens that are treated as Digimon named [Amon of Crimson Flame] and [Umon of Blue Thunder]. For a more detailed explanation of how tokens work, check the official rule manual.

No, they can't. The [Amon of Crimson Flame] and [Umon of Blue Thunder] tokens played by this card's effect can't become targets for effects with requirements related to play cost or level because these tokens don't have a play cost or level.
Card Q&A.q: Can [Amon of Crimson Flame] and [Umon of Blue Thunder] tokens played by this card's effect become targets for "Digimon with play costs of X or less" effects or "level X or higher/lower Digimon" effects?

Card Q&A.a: Yes, it can. Even if you have only 1 [Amon of Crimson Flame] or [Umon of Blue Thunder] token, it will be deleted and  will activate.
Card Q&A.q: Can this card's [All Turns] effect activate  and delete my [Amon of Crimson Flame] or [Umon of Blue Thunder] when I only have one or the other?

Card Q&A.a: No, it only activates once. No matter how many [Amon of Crimson Flame] and/or [Umon of Blue Thunder] you delete at one time with this effect,  will only activate once.
Card Q&A.q: If this card's [All Turns] effect deletes 2 of my [Amon of Crimson Flame] and/or [Umon of Blue Thunder], does  activate twice?

Card Q&A.a: "When [...] would leave the battle area" refers to when this Digimon is placed in the trash, returned to the hand/deck, placed in the security stack, moved to the breeding area, or placed under another card.
Card Q&A.q: What does this card's "When [...] would [...] leave the battle area" mean, exactly?

Effect: [On Play][When Digivolving] Play 1 [Amon of Crimson Flame] (Digimon/Red/6000 DP/＜Rush＞) Token and 1 [Umon of Blue Thunder] (Digimon/Yellow/6000 DP/＜Blocker＞) Token.
[All Turns] When this Digimon would digivolve or leave the battle area, delete all of your [Amon of Crimson Flame] and [Umon of Blue Thunder]. If this effect deletes, ＜Recovery +1 (Deck)＞.
